# annotation body

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:annotationBody`](gmeow-annotationBody.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/annotationBody>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notes`](../../slices/notes.md)

The note that serves as the body of an annotation — the content being attached. Functional per relator: one body per [`Annotation`](../classes/gmeow-Annotation.md). Optional: a highlight or bookmark has no body.

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Annotation`](../classes/gmeow-Annotation.md) -> [`gmeow:Note`](../classes/gmeow-Note.md); functional
